questions.stem: All of the following statements are correct about depression EXCEPT:

options.label: A
options.text: Depression is the most common psychiatric disorder in the world.

options.label: B
options.text: Females have a higher lifetime risk of developing depression compared to males.

options.label: C
options.text: Depression is the most common cause of suicide.

options.label: D
options.text: Excluding tobacco use disorder, depression is the most common psychiatric disorder in India.
